fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.label: Firewall throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Firewall throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled by using appmix transactions.

threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.label: Threat Prevention throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Threat Prevention throughput is measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, file blocking, and logging enabled using appmix transactions.

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput
test_conditions: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64 KB HTTP transactions and logging enabled.

concurrent_sessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
test_conditions: Maximum concurrent sessions are measured by using HTTP transactions.

new_sessions_per_sec.label: New sessions per second
test_conditions: New sessions per second is measured with application override by using 1 byte HTTP transactions.

vsys_base.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: Adding virtual systems over the base quantity requires a separately purchased license.

raw.Management I/O: 10/100/1000 out-of-band management port (1), USB port (1), RJ45 console port (1), and USB-C console port (1)
raw.Trusted Platform Module (TPM): Integrated with TPM for secure boot, hardware root of trust, and securing system secrets.
raw.Maximum Current Consumption: 4 A @ 12 VDC; *With one or more provided AC adapters.
raw.EMI: FCC Class A, CE Class A, and VCCI Class A
raw.Environment: Operating temperature: 32°F to 104°F, 0°C to 40°C; Nonoperating temperature: -4°F to 158°F, -20°C to 70°C; Passive cooling: PA-501, PA-505, PA-510, PA-520, PA-520-5G, PA-540, PA-545-POE, PA-550, and PA-555-POE

footnotes.*: Firewall throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled by using appmix transactions.
footnotes.†: Threat Prevention throughput is measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, file blocking, and logging enabled using appmix transactions.
footnotes.‡: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64 KB HTTP transactions and logging enabled.
footnotes.§: Maximum concurrent sessions are measured by using HTTP transactions.
footnotes.||: New sessions per second is measured with application override by using 1 byte HTTP transactions.
footnotes.#: Adding virtual systems over the base quantity requires a separately purchased license.
